subject: Strategic recap — CFO decision path & procurement ask
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marie Landes <marie.landes@brightpathhealth.com>, David Cho <david.cho@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic recap — CFO decision path & procurement ask

Hi Marie / David — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to help your CFO and procurement team evaluate Redwood.

TL;DR
- Primary business outcomes discussed: 60–70% reduction in per-conversation inference cost for your clinician assistant workflows; predictable latency under 200ms p50 for triage flows; ability to keep PHI inside your VPC.
- Key pain: current vendor variability (5–15% degraded accuracy under load), unpredictable token costs, and no clear path for on-prem data residency for regulated cohorts.
- Proposal: a two-phase program — short pilot (4–6 weeks) to validate latency & quality, followed by a 12-month Dedicated commit for production rollout if pilot KPIs met.

What we captured (detailed)
- Goals / success metrics: (1) reduce token cost by ~60% (model + quantization + caching); (2) p50 latency <200ms for <1k tokens; (3) retention of encryption + audit logs for compliance; (4) integrate with your EHR via a narrow API gateway.
- Risks called out by BrightPath: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency for EU/CA patients, indemnity limits in standard T&Cs.
- Procurement path you described: procurement + security questionnaire -> SOC evidence review -> PO & SOW -> legal redlines -> FY approval (CFO). Target internal decision window: Q4 2026.

Asks / next steps (action owners)
1) Marie / David: confirm the primary budget owner and target decision date (CFO office). If possible, please share the procurement contact and any internal security checklist. (action: BrightPath)
2) Redwood (Camila): provide one-page CFO summary (ROI/TCO), SOC 2 artifacts, indicative pricing and a short SOW. (attached: BrightPath_Redwood_MAPlan_v1.pdf)
3) Redwood (Sergio): produce an indicative pricing worksheet and optional trial configuration for the pilot.
4) Redwood (Monica): prepare SOC 2 evidence bundle and quick answers to your security questionnaire.

Proposed timeline
- 9/16: Redwood delivers CFO one-pager + indicative pricing + SOC 2 artifacts
- 9/20: Procurement walkthrough call (30–45m) with Redwood (Camila / Sergio / Monica) and BrightPath procurement/security
- End of Sept: Pilot contract (SOW + limited PO) to kick off 4–6 week pilot

If that aligns, I will draft a short one-pager tailored to CFO priorities and send the artifacts by Wednesday EOD.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick follow to Seattle time if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Subject: Re: Strategic recap — CFO decision path & procurement ask

Camila — thank you for the clear recap. A few clarifying items from the CFO/procurement side: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance: we will need SOC 2 Type II report and evidence that logs and audit trails are retained for a minimum of 12 months. Is Redwood able to provide a SOC 2 report for your hosted environment and separate guidance for VPC/on-prem deployments?

2) Data residency: we have a subset of EU-resident patients. Can the pilot be scoped so that EU data is routed to our EU region only? We need confirmation on regions and egress controls.

3) Pricing / SOW: please share an indicative invoice-level estimate for the pilot (not just per-token ranges) and a sample SOW outlining responsibilities. The CFO will want a line-item expectation of costs over a 12-month commit vs pilot.

4) Legal / Indemnity: our team will likely request a couple of redlines around indemnity and data processing addendum — do you have a standard DPA we can start from?

Request: Can you produce a one-page CFO-facing summary focused on quantifiable savings and procurement steps? If we receive that + SOC2 artifacts by 9/16, the CFO would consider slotting the procurement review for the week of 9/20.

Thanks — copying David (procurement) and will ask him to share the internal questionnaire.

Best,
Marie Landes
Chief Financial Officer
BrightPath Health
marie.landes@brightpathhealth.com

Compliance / DPA
- Monica will attach the SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA. For VPC/on-prem we provide a separate guidance pack with controls and deployment checklist.

Indicative pricing (high level)
- Pilot (4 weeks, managed pilot): $12,000 – $18,000 flat (covers infra, model tuning, monitoring, and up to 1M tokens).
- 12-month Dedicated reserved (recommended for production economics): $85k – $120k/mo depending on cluster size and burst policies. This includes predictable throughput, autoscaling thresholds and SRE SLA.
- Alternate: Monthly consumption with commit banding (3–6 month) if you want lower up-front.

Attached: BrightPath_Indicative_Pricing_20260915.xlsx (indicative line items, optional add-ons: on-prem bundle, advanced observability retention).
